# Kaichen Power - Diesel Generator Sets Manufacturer

> Jiangsu Kaichen Power Equipment Co., Ltd. is a professional diesel generator sets manufacturer based in Yangzhou, China. We design and produce diesel generator sets ranging from 20 kVA to 3000 kVA, including open type, silent canopy, rainproof canopy, containerized silent, mobile silent and mobile trailer units. We partner with Cummins, SDEC, Weichai, Volvo, Yuchai and Kaichen power units, paired with high-quality alternators from Stamford, Leroy Somer and Mecc Alte.

## Engine Brand Categories
- [Cummins Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/cummins/) - Open diesel generator sets powered by Cummins engines (Dongfeng Cummins and Chongqing Cummins are unified as Cummins for export enquiries)
- [SDEC Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/sdec/) - Open diesel generator sets built on SDEC engines
- [Weichai Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/weichai/) - Open diesel generator sets built on Weichai engines
- [Volvo Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/volvo/) - Open diesel generator sets built on Volvo Penta engines
- [Yuchai Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/yuchai/) - Open diesel generator sets built on Yuchai engines
- [Kaichen Power Units](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/kaichen/) - Kaichen open, silent, containerized and trailer generator sets

## Enclosure and Mobility Categories
- [Silent Canopy Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/silent-canopy/) - Soundproof canopy generators for offices, hospitals, residential areas and urban projects
- [Rainproof Canopy Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/rainproof-canopy/) - Outdoor rain-protected canopy units for site power without a full container
- [Containerized Silent Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/containerized-silent/) - 20ft and 40ft containerized generator solutions for outdoor, remote and unattended sites
- [Mobile Silent Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/mobile-silent/) - Silent trailer units for mobile backup and rental applications
- [Mobile Trailer Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/categories/mobile-trailer/) - Trailer-mounted open units for construction sites and mobile power projects

## Applications
- [Industry Solutions](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/) - Backup and prime power for commercial, medical, factory, mining, transportation and data center applications
- [Industrial Power Solutions](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/) - Backup and prime power for factories and industrial facilities
- [Commercial Building Power](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/) - Reliable standby power for hotels, hospitals and commercial buildings
- [Data Center Power](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/) - N+1 redundant diesel generator power systems for data centers
- [Mining & Oilfield Power](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/) - Heavy-duty generators for mining sites and oilfield operations

## Specifications
- Power range: 20 kVA - 3000 kVA
- Engine brands: Cummins, SDEC, Weichai, Volvo, Yuchai, Kaichen
- Enclosure types: open, silent canopy, rainproof canopy, containerized silent, mobile silent, mobile trailer
- Alternator brands: Stamford, Leroy Somer, Mecc Alte
- Voltage: 220V single phase - 11kV three phase
- Frequency: 50 Hz / 60 Hz
- Noise level: 65-75 dB(A) at 7 meters for silent type
- Control system: DeepSea, SmartGen, ComAp automatic controller with 4G remote monitoring
- Certification: CE, ISO 9001, ISO 14001
- Warranty: 1 year or 1,000 hours (extendable)
- Lead time: 7-15 days standard, 25-45 days custom
- Export markets: Southeast Asia, Middle East, Africa, South America, Eastern Europe, Central Asia
